name: Can I clean my main drain myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I clean my main drain myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor clogs in individual drains can sometimes be addressed with plungers or simple drain cleaners, main drain blockages are typically more complex and require professional expertise. DIY attempts on main lines can inadvertently push blockages further, damage pipes, or lead to messy and unsanitary backups. Professionals have specialized equipment like drain snakes, augers, and hydro jetters, along with the experience to diagnose the issue accurately and clear the blockage safely and effectively, preventing future problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Main drain blockages are best handled by professionals due to specialized equipment and potential risks of DIY methods.
